text: Given a valid API key, when domotz_alerts_list is called with a valid from_time/to_time window, then it returns the account's alerts for that window; when from_time or to_time is missing, then it returns an invalid_argument envelope without calling Domotz.
Given more alerts than fit one page, when domotz_alerts_list is called with page_size/offset, then it returns has_more and next_offset the same way every other list tool does.
Given an alert_id, when domotz_alerts_resolve is called without confirm: true, then it returns sent: false and Domotz is never called.
Given an alert_id and confirm: true, when domotz_alerts_resolve is called, then it calls POST /alert/{alert_id}/resolve and returns sent: true.
Given a real Domotz test account, when an agent resolves a real alert end to end, then the alert shows resolved in the Domotz portal.
steps: Obtain a Domotz trial/test account API key
Trigger or find a currently-open alert
Call domotz_alerts_resolve with confirm: true for that alert_id
Check the Domotz portal for the alert's status
expect: The alert shows resolved in the Domotz portal
evidence: needs a real vendor account — not available at design or dev time; see references/mcp-track.md 2.5 (no test account does not block this ticket)

text: Given a valid API key, when domotz_alert_rules_list is called, then it returns the account's Alert Rules; when domotz_alert_rules_get is called with an unknown alert_rule_id, then it returns a not_found envelope.

Given an alert_rule_id and agent_id, when domotz_alert_rules_bind_agent / domotz_alert_rules_unbind_agent are called without confirm: true, then they return sent: false; with confirm: true, then they call POST / DELETE on the agent binding path.

Given an alert_rule_id, agent_id and device_id, when domotz_alert_rules_bind_device / domotz_alert_rules_unbind_device are called without confirm: true, then they return sent: false; with confirm: true, then they call POST / DELETE on the device binding path.

Given no credentials, when tools/list is called, then all 8 new tools are listed; given a 401/404/429/5xx response from Domotz, when any new tool is called, then it returns the matching error envelope code.
Given the full existing test suite, when it is run after this change, then all pre-existing tools (21) keep their exact tools/list snapshot and parameter-type contract.
